title: Kaizen routines catalog
description: Validates skills/workflow/domain/routines.yaml — the single source of truth for kaizen workflow routines.

routine.description: Routine name returned by detect_routine() when no trigger_words match. Must reference a real routine.

stages.description: Stage chain returned by get_stages() for an unknown routine name. Last-ditch backstop.

stage_skill_map.description: Phase C: stage name → implementing skill. Stages without a 1:1 skill (e.g. simplify = slash command, schema-routine internals) are intentionally absent.

name.description: kebab-case identifier; matches the slash-command flag value (e.g. schema=audit)

kind.description: hardcoded = built into workflow.sh case statement; schema = points at schemas/<name>/schema.yaml

tier.description: Resolution tier. project > user > built-in (first hit wins).

trigger_words.description: Substrings that, if found in the user's prompt (lowercased), select this routine via verb-detection. Empty = no verb-detection (schema= flag required).

stages.description: Ordered list of stage names. Each stage maps to a skill via the stage-skill mapping table in references/orchestration.md. Empty allowed for kind=hardcoded routines like 'custom'.

end_state.description: One-sentence description of what the routine produces on success.

coding_skills.description: Cross-link to applicable kaizen:coding-skills principles + sibling discipline skills. The 8 classic principles plus karpathy (active coding discipline from v1.32.0).

schema_path.description: For kind=schema: relative path (or absolute with ~ expansion) to the detailed schema yaml.

description.description: Multi-line prose describing when to use this routine.
